info.name: Apache Airflow Get a Source Code

params.name: file_token
params.description:
The key containing the encrypted path to the file. Encryption and decryption take place only on
the server. This prevents the client from reading an non-DAG file. This also ensures API
extensibility, because the format of encrypted data may change.

items.docs: Get a source code using file token.

params.name: limit
params.description: The numbers of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
The name of the field to order the results by.
Prefix a field name with `-` to reverse the sort order.

*New in version 2.1.0*

params.name: tags
params.description:
List of tags to filter results.

*New in version 2.2.0*

params.name: only_active
params.description:
Only filter active DAGs.

*New in version 2.1.1*

params.name: dag_id_pattern
params.description: If set, only return DAGs with dag_ids matching this pattern.
